name: CI recovery workflow

version.change_summary: Initial semantic workflow definition for the sample local workspace.

intent: Recover a failing CI run by reproducing the failure, classifying the root cause, applying a bounded fix, and stopping production-impacting changes at a human gate.
inputs: CI logs and failed check names
Package manager and local test commands
outputs: Recorded trace of commands and decisions
allowed_actions: Inspect git state and dependency metadata
Run local tests, lint, and build commands
Apply a bounded patch for known failures
forbidden_actions: Force push, reset, or discard unrelated user changes
Rotate credentials or change production secrets
Merge production-impacting changes without a human gate

human_gates.when: The proposed fix changes deployment behavior, credentials, migrations, or production data handling.

steps.name: Inspect branch state and package manager
steps.intent: Collect deterministic repository state before any repair attempt.

steps.name: Run tests, lint, and build
steps.intent: Reproduce or confirm the failing check with the same command family.

steps.name: Classify failing output into known labels
steps.intent: Map observed failure output to a known workflow or automation gap.

steps.name: Apply known recovery recipe
steps.intent: Use deterministic recipes for repeated known failure modes.

steps.name: Diagnose unknown failures and propose a patch
steps.intent: Use senior judgment only for ambiguous failures outside the known taxonomy.

steps.name: Approve production-impacting changes
steps.intent: Stop high-risk changes before merge or deployment.

success_criteria: The failing check is reproduced locally or marked environment-only.
The final command set is recorded in the trace.
A passing verification command exists for the selected fix.
Production-impacting changes are stopped at a human gate.
